files.initialValue:
version: 2
jobs:
  build:
    needs: []
    steps:
      -
        checkout:
          ref: "candidate"
      -
        setup:
          runtime: "24"
      -
        install:
          mode: "locked"
      -
        check:
          name: "lint"
      -
        check:
          name: "unit"
      -
        build:
          artifact: "app"
      -
        upload:
          artifact: "app"
  staging:
    needs:
      - "build"
    steps:
      -
        download:
          artifact: "app"
      -
        deploy:
          artifact: "app"
          environment: "staging"
      -
        verify:
          artifact: "app"
          environment: "staging"
  production:
    needs:
      - "build"
    steps:
      -
        download:
          artifact: "app"
      -
        approve:
          artifact: "app"
          environment: "production"
          policy: "approval.yaml"
      -
        deploy:
          artifact: "app"
          environment: "production"
          policy: "rollout.yaml"
export const checkoutTotal = (prices) => prices.reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0);

cases.title: Approved candidate
cases.description: Technical checks and the current approval pass.

cases.title: No approval
cases.description: The release manager denied this release.

cases.title: Approval names another package
cases.description: A previous package's decision must not transfer.

cases.title: Expired approval
cases.description: The authorized window ended before this run.

cases.title: Staging fails
cases.description: Human authorization cannot compensate for failed staging.
